constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied audio reference is a low engine rumble.
The setting is an unlit paved area large enough for the car to advance and pass.
The car is a dark-bodied vehicle with a visible front grille and hood.
The headlights cast pale, narrow beams across the pavement.

summary.text: A car emerges from near-total darkness, advances with its headlights on, and passes out of view.

description.text: The opening is almost entirely black. A flat, unlit paved surface occupies the lower part of the frame, while the upper area remains a void. The black is not pure flatness; a faint tonal difference separates the ground from the air above, enough to suggest depth but not enough to identify a horizon. The only spatial cue is a distant pair of headlights that switch on at the far end, small pale points hovering against the darkness. Their weak beams reveal a faint patch of ground and the suggestion of a vehicle body still swallowed by shadow.
The rumble grows under the image, giving the darkness weight without yet showing the full car.
Near-total darkness fills the frame, with no readable horizon or ground detail at first.
A low engine rumble rises from silence.
Two dim headlights ignite at the far end, small pale points against the black.
A faint electrical ignition tick accompanies the headlights.
The headlights cast a narrow, low glow that barely separates the far end of the vehicle from the surrounding darkness.

The car advances out of the dark. Its headlight beams spread wider across the pavement, revealing a low front end, a dark hood, and a horizontal grille that catches a thin edge of light. The beams catch small variations in the pavement—patches, seams, and a soft reflective sheen—that appear only where the light passes. The vehicle moves slowly and steadily, closing the distance while the surrounding night stays otherwise empty.
The engine note deepens and tire noise joins it, anchoring the advance in the physical ground.
The car eases forward, and its headlight beams widen across the paved ground.
The low engine rumble deepens.
The front of the vehicle advances toward the viewer, letting the grille and the leading edge of the hood catch the light.
Tires begin rolling on pavement with a soft, steady hiss.
The dark hood and horizontal grille become clearer as the bodywork emerges from the black.

The car moves across the foreground and out of view. The headlights rake the ground and nearby surfaces as the vehicle passes, briefly revealing texture and then sliding away. The headlights sweep across the foreground in a broad arc, throwing brief highlights onto the ground before the beams point away. The car's mass reads as a dark silhouette around the lit front, and the gap between the passing body and the viewer closes for a moment before opening again. The rumble peaks, tire noise passes close, and the bodywork recedes into the same near-black that opened the piece.
By the end, only a faint trace of light remains before darkness settles.
The car rolls past the viewing position, its headlights sweeping across the foreground.
The engine rumble reaches its fullest.
The receding bodywork darkens as the beams swing away.
Tires pass close by with a brief, close hiss.
Darkness closes back over the frame behind the departing car.

soundscape: Diegetic only: a low engine rumble, a faint electrical ignition tick, and tires rolling on pavement.
